primary.name: report-amz
primary.description: Builds Amazon research HTML reports by using jyamzon for every data-acquisition step and the US Summer Products Research 2026 frontend only for rendering. Use when the user says /report-amz, asks to combine /jyamzon crawler data with /us-summer-products-research-2026 HTML, or wants crawler-backed Amazon product reports without SellerSprite MCP.
